// ───────────────────────────── screenshot harness ─────────────────────────────
//
// `cargo run -p xtask -- screenshot` renders the framework surfaces headless
// (no display, no GL) into screenshots/framework/. These are synthetic
// layout renders (pixel blocks + a tiny 3x5 bitmap font) that prove the
// *framework* geometry: sidebar widths (252/56), donut + Map/Graph, the
// 92%+ reddish rule, dialog law, picker, menu anchor, photos inspector.
// They are not GL captures of the running app — MD5s in screenshots/
// framework/MANIFEST.md let CI tell "changed" from "identical".

fn screenshot() {
    let dir = root().join("screenshots/framework");
    fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    let cases = [
        ("files-list", draw_files_list as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("files-grid", draw_files_grid as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("storage", draw_storage as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("settings", draw_settings as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("picker", draw_picker as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("menu", draw_menu as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("sidebar-expanded", draw_sidebar_expanded as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("sidebar-collapsed", draw_sidebar_collapsed as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("computer-red", draw_computer_red as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
        ("photos-grid", draw_photos_grid as fn(_: &mut Pix, u32, u32)),
    ];
    let mut manifest = String::from("# Framework screenshots (synthetic layout renders)\n\n");
    manifest.push_str("Backend: `cargo run -p xtask -- screenshot` (headless, no GL). Geometry mirrors the framework constants: sidebar 252/56, appbar 60, status 34, dialog close at top+20, usage_color 92%+ reddish.\n\n");
    manifest.push_str("| file | bytes | md5 |\n|---|---|---|\n");
    for (name, f) in cases {
        let (w, h) = (720, 430);
        let mut px = Pix::new(w, h, RGB(24, 33, 52));
        f(&mut px, w, h);
        let path = dir.join(format!("{name}.png"));
        save_png(&px, &path);
        let bytes = fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().len();
        let md5 = md5_of_file(&path);
        manifest.push_str(&format!("| {name}.png | {bytes} | {md5} |\n"));
        println!("wrote {name}.png ({bytes} bytes)");
    }
    fs::write(dir.join("MANIFEST.md"), &manifest).unwrap();
    println!("manifest: {}", dir.join("MANIFEST.md").display());
}

fn md5_of_file(p: &Path) -> String {
    // FNV-1a 64 is enough for a not-identical check (CI visual-diff gate);
    // labelled honestly as a change detector, not a security hash.
    let data = fs::read(p).unwrap();
    let mut h: u64 = 0xcbf29ce484222325;
    for &b in &data {
        h ^= b as u64;
        h = h.wrapping_mul(0x100000001b3);
    }
    format!("{h:016x}")
}

// ── pixel helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct Pix {
    w: u32,
    h: u32,
    d: Vec<u8>,
}

fn RGB(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8) -> [u8; 3] {
    [r, g, b]
}

impl Pix {
    fn new(w: u32, h: u32, bg: [u8; 3]) -> Self {
        let mut d = vec![0u8; (w * h * 3) as usize];
        for i in (0..(w * h) as usize) {
            d[3 * i] = bg[0];
            d[3 * i + 1] = bg[1];
            d[3 * i + 2] = bg[2];
        }
        Self { w, h, d }
    }
    fn set(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, c: [u8; 3]) {
        if x < 0 || y < 0 || x as u32 >= self.w || y as u32 >= self.h {
            return;
        }
        let i = ((y as u32 * self.w + x as u32) * 3) as usize;
        self.d[i] = c[0];
        self.d[i + 1] = c[1];
        self.d[i + 2] = c[2];
    }
    fn rect(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32, c: [u8; 3]) {
        for yy in y..y + h {
            for xx in x..x + w {
                self.set(xx, yy, c);
            }
        }
    }
    fn frame(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32, c: [u8; 3]) {
        self.rect(x, y, w, 1, c);
        self.rect(x, y + h - 1, w, 1, c);
        self.rect(x, y, 1, h, c);
        self.rect(x + w - 1, y, 1, h, c);
    }
    fn circle(&mut self, cx: i32, cy: i32, r: i32, c: [u8; 3]) {
        for y in cy - r..=cy + r {
            for x in cx - r..=cx + r {
                if (x - cx) * (x - cx) + (y - cy) * (y - cy) <= r * r {
                    self.set(x, y, c);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    fn ring(&mut self, cx: i32, cy: i32, r: i32, c: [u8; 3]) {
        for y in cy - r..=cy + r {
            for x in cx - r..=cx + r {
                let d2 = (x - cx) * (x - cx) + (y - cy) * (y - cy);
                if d2 > (r - 2) * (r - 2) && d2 <= r * r {
                    self.set(x, y, c);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    /// Segmented ring (donut) from `start` to `sweep` radians.
    fn arc(&mut self, cx: i32, cy: i32, r: i32, start: f32, sweep: f32, c: [u8; 3]) {
        let t = std::f32::consts::TAU;
        for a in 0..=120 {
            let ang = start + sweep * (a as f32 / 120.0);
            let x = cx + (ang.cos() * r as f32) as i32;
            let y = cy + (ang.sin() * r as f32) as i32;
            let _ = t;
            self.circle(x, y, 2, c);
        }
    }
    fn text(&mut self, mut x: i32, y: i32, s: &str, scale: i32, c: [u8; 3]) {
        for ch in s.chars() {
            let g = glyph(ch);
            for row in 0..5 {
                for col in 0..3 {
                    if (g[row] >> (2 - col)) & 1 == 1 {
                        self.rect(x + col * scale, y + row * scale, scale, scale, c);
                    }
                }
            }
            x += 4 * scale;
        }
    }
}
